name: Lim Wei Jie
bio:
Lim Wei Jie's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, during his mandatory military service. Stationed near the Changi Circuit, the roar of engines ignited a passion that would shape his career. After completing his service, he pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Singapore, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. He started his motorsport career at a small local racing team, gaining experience in data analysis and race strategy. 

Lim's strategic approach is rooted in meticulous preparation and adaptability. He is known for his ability to quickly analyze complex data during races and make decisive calls under pressure. He joined Signature Racing 15 years ago and has been an important component of their success. He's noted as being especially strong in wet-weather strategies. His flexibility and calm demeanor make him a valuable asset in the high-stakes environment of motorsport.

What sets Lim apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with intuitive decision-making. He isn't afraid to take calculated risks, and his innovative strategies have often given Signature Racing a competitive edge. He is known as the 'Rain Master' in the team, due to his ability to predict weather changes and adapt strategy accordingly.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Lim is of average height, with a lean build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a lucky pen that he uses to mark strategy changes on his whiteboard.
Drinks green tea throughout the race, believing it helps him stay focused.
